title: Biodegradable Prussian blue/manganese dioxide core–shell nanoparticles with open cages for imaging-guided chemo-photothermal combined therapy of cancer cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10372-10379
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07493B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ying Gao, Jinbo Xue, Yuebo Yang, Dongxiao Bian, Luyao Liu, Ming Zhu, Tao Yang, Le Liu
The open cage-like Prussian blue/manganese dioxide (PBMn) core–shell nanoplatform utilizes its PB core for photothermal therapy and its MnO2 shell to enhance MRI, enabling imaging-guided synergistic chemo-photothermal therapy.
